sourceGaps: 1995T1: The question's Gibbs-energy table prints Cl(aq) and OH(aq) without charges, while the solution equations print chloride and hydroxide species with charges where applicable. The key's zero-order condition and rate expression follow its ii) heading rather than a separately printed iii) heading, and both remain attached to the complete 1.2 request.

1995T2: The actual printed question 2.1 gives the chloride background as $2.6\times10^3$ (a positive exponent); the old text layer instead reports $2.6\times10^{-3}$. The native image governs this transcription. Question 2.2 gives $4.9\times10^{-2}$, while the key prints $4.9\times10^{-4}$; the key then gives $2.9\times10^{-4}$ and subtracts $2.9\times10^{-3}$. All of these native disagreements are retained without algebraic repair.

1995T3: The collection supplies structural drawings for all five responses, without a separate explanatory method or point rubric. Every native alternative, substituent and stereochemical label is retained in bounded source artwork crops; no additional stereoisomer or inferred marking is supplied.

1995T4: The native unmatched opening brace and quote in the note following 4.1 are retained as literal punctuation. All five native stereochemical units, both alternative monomers, both activation routes and the complete copolymer scheme are preserved.
